subject: Follow-up: propose three staggered slots for hands-on evaluation
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@edgecommerce.com>, Anil Rao <anil@edgecommerce.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-10T13:45:00-08:00
Subject: Follow-up: propose three staggered slots for hands-on evaluation

Hi Lena / Anil —

Thanks again for a productive discovery call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps:

- Recap: you are focused on reducing inference cost spikes for peak checkout traffic and want a hands-on run with our Dedicated routing and prefix cache to validate latency and cost improvements.
- Demo goal: run a short end-to-end scenario (checkout + post-purchase messaging) with your ops and infra leads, show request routing, and capture post-demo cost/latency numbers.
- Estimated attendees: your infra lead + growth PM + us (Eng + Solutions).

I can hold the following staggered slots (all PT) — they are compact so we can get a working run and leave time for follow-ups:
1) 2026-12-12 09:30–10:00 PT (30m) — best for ops deep-dive
2) 2026-12-12 13:00–13:30 PT (30m) — mid-day window
3) 2026-12-13 08:00–08:30 PT (30m) — early option for East Coast stakeholders

Attachment: redwood_hands-on-agenda.pdf (pdf) — short agenda + required access checklist. Also attached: edge_requirements_notes.txt (txt) — my notes from the call.

Because our engineers are in high demand this week, I can provision a reserved slot for you but will need a firm confirmation within 6 hours for each slot. If we don't hear back, I'll release the slot and open it to other pilots. If none of the above work, tell me the top two windows that do and I'll try to compress.

Can you confirm which slot works and who will join? If you prefer a calendar invite, I can send one once you confirm.

Thanks —
Stephanie Nguyen
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0192

Hi Stephanie —

Appreciate the clear recap and the agenda. We had an exec conflict pop up this morning that pulled our infra lead out of the original window. Sorry about the short notice.

Of your three options, the only windows that look feasible for at least two of our stakeholders are:
- 2026-12-12 13:00–13:30 PT
- 2026-12-13 08:00–08:30 PT

If you can hold 13:00 PT on the 12th for a short time, we'll try to lock it down. Otherwise, the 13th early slot is a safe fallback.

Attendees likely: Anil Rao (infra) and myself; I may add our Growth PM if they can shift a call.

Would you mind holding 13:00 PT for 4 hours while we confirm internally? Otherwise let us know the window after which you'll open it up.

Thanks —
Lena Ortiz
Head of Platform Partnerships
Edge Commerce
lena.ortiz@edgecommerce.com

Stephanie / Karthik —

I can have Eng earmark the 2026-12-12 13:00–13:30 PT slot and the 2026-12-13 08:00–08:30 PT slot for Edge, but we should be explicit about hold rules so we don't overbook. Proposed hold policy:

- Hold timeframe: we will hold a slot for up to 4 hours pending final confirmation from the account contact.
- If confirmation comes within that 4h window, we'll send a calendar invite with joined engineer + runbook.
- If the slot isn't confirmed, release it and offer the customer the next available window (we can propose compressed 20m run if they need).

Stephanie — please call out the 4-hour release time in your follow-up to Lena, and ask for final attendee list. Also request any short-lived access tokens or test data pointers we need (I can prep infra).

Karthik — want me to provision a small batch of GPU capacity for the session? If yes, I'll reserve one node from 12:40–14:00 PT to be safe.

Ben
